facts.fact: FAO Cameroon says the government, with FAO and UNFPA, launched on 21 October 2025 a field test in Bamenda, Buea, Fongo Tongo and Mora of an earth observation method that uses remote sensing to estimate cultivated areas and crop types for the agriculture and livestock census.
facts.system: earth observation method for the General Census of Agriculture and Livestock

facts.fact: FAO Cameroon says the government, with FAO and UNFPA support, launched on 21 October 2025 a field test (to 7 November 2025) of a hybrid census method ahead of the fourth General Population and Housing Census merged with the agriculture and livestock census, scheduled for 2026.

systems.owner: Government of Cameroon with FAO and UNFPA

CMR.note: Document mentions only compliance with unnamed international standards, no standards body or named IT standard.
